WITH exam_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    COUNT(*) as exam_count
  FROM Examination
  WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(exam_count) as total_exams,
    COUNT(*) as num_groups
  FROM exam_counts
),
exam_fractions AS (
  SELECT
    ec.ID,
    ec.exam_count,
    ec.exam_count / CAST(t.total_exams AS FLOAT) as fraction,
    1.0 / t.num_groups as avg_fraction
  FROM exam_counts ec, totals t
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    exam_count,
    fraction,
    fraction - avg_fraction as excess
  FROM exam_fractions
  WHERE fraction > avg_fraction
)
SELECT
  ID,
  exam_count,
  fraction,
  excess
FROM filtered
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;
